name: calamine
description: Fast xlsx/xls/xlsb/ods reader — calamine compiled to WebAssembly. One artifact for Node, Bun, Deno, browsers and edge workers.
author: Lucas Arcanjo
//types: For TypeScript on the legacy `moduleResolution: node`, which cannot read an exports map at all and would otherwise see this package as untyped. Deliberately no `main` alongside it: a bundler too old to understand exports would then resolve the Node entry into a browser build, and failing loudly beats shipping node:fs to the browser.

scripts.prepack: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/check-publish.mjs
scripts.fixtures: bun run fixtures:small && node bench/make-fixtures.mjs medium large
scripts.test: bun run test:rust && bun run test:node && bun run test:browser
scripts.test:node: for f in test/node/*.test.ts; do echo "── $f"; node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.licenses:check: bun run licenses && git diff --exit-code -- THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md
scripts.fixtures:small: node bench/make-fixtures.mjs small && node test/support/make-date-fixture.ts && ./test/support/fetch-fixtures.sh && node test/support/make-crafted-fixtures.ts
